parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity standard type, relation, value, units, comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, compound_records on record_id, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter for human Pim-1 kinase by target name and organism, and for IC50 standard type. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, relation, value, units, comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
